as_told.title: Epstein's interest in the Casimir effect for propulsion

plain: Jeffrey Epstein, the financier, is said to have been "obsessed" with the Casimir effect, a tiny force that appears between two very close metal plates in empty space, and, according to Michels, to have hosted gravity conferences and known about a physics theory of Michels's former colleague, the researcher Eric Weinstein. Michels tells this himself on two episodes, insisting that "this is all in the emails", meaning Epstein's leaked emails. In one of them he speaks only of the Casimir obsession, linking it to interest in new ways of propelling craft.
